policies.scope: Two newly executable Standard candidate roots and eight necessary noncollectible old-Colossal appendages. All seven Ozumat definitions already exist and count0new; they are independently pinned and unchanged. No source-specific past pool, executable-only filter or Wild-format certification is added.
policies.wannabe: Native Prepare action and actual Combo entry. At each accepted Combo context, query original committed hand plays for the current global turn, excluding only its own enclosing paid play ID when present. Countered actual plays count; summons, powers and Prepare actions do not. Frozen first acceptance and later repetition views follow the native Combo interpreter. Grant numeric growth to the original live physical source with BuffCapturedMinion.
policies.jade: Query original played_cards records across the game and count exact cost2 plus PaymentType.MANA. Printed2-cost reduced/free cards, health payment, hero powers, Prepare/trade and spell-only effect casts do not impersonate2-Mana hand payments. One ordinary GenerateFromPool(count2,collectibleMINION,printedCost8) freezes a complete native batch and applies the same captured cost delta to both generated cards, with ordinary minimum0.
policies.history_boundary: The trusted played_cards ledger is the existing committed physical hand-play contract. Generated Combo origins use their native activation without inventing paid PlayRecords; a generated source has no current paid root to subtract. This does not expand or certify unconfirmed automatic-play counting policies or M0/M6.
policies.drills: Two distinct exact2/3 Rush drill faces are independent complete ordinary minions. Gaia attack-reward parent remains unsupported.
policies.stalks: Four distinct1/2 stalks use native natural owner-end effect triggers and RandomDamage2 to a current enemy character. Base2 comes from each complete raw TAG_SCRIPT_DATA_NUM_1=2, explicitly omitted by the primary display using the existing printed-script normalization. Damage, health-rule attachments, source lifetime, native end repetition and source metadata remain public; Xhilag growth parent is not implemented or inferred.
policies.wings: Two exact2/1 Rush wings react only to their own original positive settled damage result. Capture the real committed health event and use InvokeHealthResult to recheck the actual damaged target allocation in fresh state; original minions use FreezeCapturedMinion and unchanged original heroes use ordinary Freeze. No same-ID reentry/face/controller replacement can borrow the old target. Source can die after dealing its actual damage; unrelated packets/zero/shield/prevention/healing do not count.
policies.source: Use only explicit reviewed trailing-counter omissions for JAIL_909/JAIL_474. Stalk numeric2 display attempt failed and is retained; final empty omission is already permitted for an explicitly pinned numeric script value, not a new broad normalization. Complete original rows and response bodies stay unchanged.
policies.gaps: Four Discovery consumer roots and Origin Stone remain unsupported. Generic choice_selected has no purpose/result and no general actual discovered-card fact or delivered-reference receipt. Board discovery history is not every Discover; no diagnostic-log scan, guessed chosen-card allocation, source-local global counter or partial Quest/reward is introduced.
